newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIAN VORU JUUST TO START SHARE ISSUE FROM JULY 23.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIAN VORU JUUST TO START SHARE ISSUE FROM JULY 23.

text.p: Voru Juust, a cheese factory in Southern Estonia, will organise an open share issue worth a little over eight million kroons from July 23 to August 6, Hansa Investments said on Monday.
Each of the 60,000 new shares will be worth 133.35 kroons, Hansa Investments said in a statement.
Voru Juust will seek a listing on the Tallinn stock exchange as soon as possible after the share issue.
The company is the largest cheese producer in Estonia and the owner of the Atleet trade mark.
In 1996 the company's net profit was 4.3 million kroons and its profit for the first three months of 1997 was 3.7 million kroons.
